Structural validation is not claimed to certify mathematics or constitute Audit A.

output_notes.note: N001 explicitly exports both pointwise orthogonality identities, the scalar coefficient formula for every normality witness, and the resulting explicit PDE. R003/F001 proves the formula, F002/F003 supply the uniform quotient majorant on a positive time interval, F004/F005 instantiate sequential dominated convergence, and S006 discharges L1 and proves the full two-sided punctured limit. The support or sequence private witnesses do not appear in the exported claim.

N004 is the whole-space identity for each positive time and each spatial coordinate, with both absolute-integrability clauses. R004/F001 is the smooth product derivative with boundary vanishing, F002 records the precise box/product measure identification and slice conditions, F003 is the zero slice integral by FTC, F004 the zero box derivative integral by Fubini, and S005 extends to whole space and rearranges the two integrals. The n=1 singleton residual factor is treated.

P includes every selected claim: absolute integrability of e at all positive times, differentiability of E, zero derivative, plus the supplied final constancy consequence. R005/S001 uses N003 and N004 with integrable finite-sum linearity to obtain 2∫u_t·(u_tt−Δ_xu); S002 invokes the pointwise zero from N001 and retains N002/N003 for well-definedness. S003 proves equality of energies at arbitrary positive times by M004 and handles equal/reversed endpoints. Normalization is unchanged and there is no assertion at zero.
